subject: Pilot credit top-up request and 3-month extension - SparkScale Labs
messages:
From: Elena Morozova <elena@sparkscale.co>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot credit top-up and extension request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. We kicked off an internal pilot and hit some unexpected usage early in the run — attached is a short CSV with last month's calls and token consumption. We are on track for the product milestone, but need an operational runway to finish the integration.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a one-time credit top-up of 75,000 tokens to cover the remainder of the pilot?
- Can the trial window be extended by 3 months (new end date Jan 31, 2028) so we can complete metrics for our series A diligence?

We can commit to milestone-based acceptance: connect events A and B (signup flow + API latency under 120ms) and a short demo at the end. If needed, Tom Bennett at VP Ventures (cc'd) would like a short summary for the fund.

I've attached sparkscale_usage_nov.csv for your review. Let me know what other info you need.

Best,
Elena Morozova
Co-founder, SparkScale Labs
elena@sparkscale.co
Attachments: sparkscale_usage_nov.csv
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morozova <elena@sparkscale.co>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom@vpventures.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot credit top-up and extension request

Hi Elena — thanks for the CSV and context. Great to hear the pilot is progressing.

Quick clarifying questions before I route for approval:
- Is the 75k token ask cumulative on top of the existing trial credits, or a replacement top-up?
- Can you confirm the expected activity window for those tokens (all in next 30 days vs evenly spread)?
- Billing contact for the pilot (we need PO/POC if finance will be involved later).

Operationally, we do offer milestone-released promo credits for accelerator pilots. I will start the exception request with a proposed structure: 75k tokens released in two tranches (40k on signature; 35k on milestone B). I will also request the 3-month extension conditioned on milestone checks and a short success demo.

If that sounds right, I will pull legal/finance in and loop in our infra ops lead (Vivek) for any rate-limit or entitlements we need to provision.

Thanks — I should have an internal decision within 48 hours.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: pilot_mop_v1.pdf (operational checklist)
From: Elena Morozova <elena@sparkscale.co>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom@vpventures.com>
Date: 2027-12-02T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot credit top-up and extension request

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:
- 75k is cumulative on top of the credits we currently have in the account.
- Expectation is heavy usage over the next 6 weeks while we finalize instrumentation, then taper. So front-loaded (roughly 60% in first 30 days).
- Billing contact: legal@sparkscale.co (for PO/contract routing), CC Anna (ops) anna@sparkscale.co on logistics.

We are comfortable with milestone gating as you outlined. SOC2 is in progress (type 1 targeted Q1 2028); happy to provide status notes and the auditor contact.

Attached the usage CSV again for reference and a short MOP (note: I left a few comments in pilot_mop_v1.pdf).

Elena

Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-03T14:22:00Z
Subject: FWD: Pilot credit top-up and extension request — approval request (SparkScale Labs)

Team — forwarding a pilot credit exception request. Summary: SparkScale Labs (deal SS-2027-0459) requests a 75k token top-up and 3-month extension to Jan 31, 2028. They are front-loading usage (60% in first 30 days). They are an accelerator-backed startup with potential platform expansion into a paid tier after series A. Tom Bennett from VP Ventures is on the thread.

Why I am asking: the 75k ask exceeds the standard promo top-up for self-serve pilots in our current playbook. However, the account has clear runway to convert and has traction signals (accelerator backing and integration with key customer pipeline).

Proposed terms for approval:
- 75k tokens total, released in two tranches: 40k on execution of a short credit addendum; 35k released on sign-off of milestone B (demo and latency < 120ms).
- Extension of trial window to 2028-01-31 conditional on milestone checks.
- Credits are non-transferable and expire 90 days after final tranche unless converted into paid credit at standard rates.

Ops note: Vivek, we may need a rate-limit and project entitlements update if approved.

Please reply with an approval/decline or edits. If approved, I will prepare the credit schedule doc and DocuSign packet.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: FWD: Pilot credit top-up and extension request — approval request (SparkScale Labs)

Approve with conditions. I agree the account has promising signals and this is a reasonable accelerator exception. Conditions:
- Legal to sign the short credit addendum with the milestone schedule and a clause that credits will be clawed back if the pilot is used for resale/third-party provisioning. Laura, can you own legal review and fast-track?
- Finance: record the credit as a contra-revenue line tied to deal SS-2027-0459. Laura, please confirm GL code.
- Ops (Vivek): provision the project entitlements and a burst policy to handle front-loaded usage; send me an ETA for provisioning.

Marissa, once you have the addendum, put the DocuSign link in HubSpot and create a task for legal and finance. After signature, we release the first tranche.

Karthik
VP, GTM
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-12-05T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot credit top-up and extension request

Elena — good news. Leadership approved a conditional exception. Summary and next steps:

What we approved
- 75,000 tokens total (cumulative). Released as: 40,000 tokens upon execution of a short credit addendum; 35,000 tokens released upon Milestone B sign-off (demo + latency < 120ms).
- Trial end date extended to 2028-01-31, contingent on milestone checks.
- Credits are non-transferable; clawback clause included for resale.

Action items for SparkScale:
1) Please review and e-sign the credit addendum here: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123
2) Send PO or confirm billing contact to legal@redwood.com if finance needs a PO.
3) Confirm acceptance of milestones and proposed dates; we will schedule the milestone review demo after provisioning.

Attachments: redwood_credit_schedule_2027-12.docx (credit schedule), pilot_mop_v1.pdf (operational notes). I have also linked the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/SS-2027-0459 and a Drive folder with the addendum: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_cDemoLink

Vivek: can you provision the entitlements and burst policy after Elena signs? Laura: looping you for legal/finance confirmation on GL code and final addendum text.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the demo.

Best,
